scripts.check: pnpm run check:lint && pnpm run check:build && pnpm run check:test && pnpm run check:frozen
scripts.check:lint: cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings && biome ci .
scripts.check:build: node scripts/lexicons.ts check && tsc -p tsconfig.json && pnpm --filter @conference/web build && cargo build --workspace --locked
scripts.test:all: pnpm run test:rust && pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run test:integration && pnpm run test:tooling && pnpm run test:e2e
scripts.test:integration: cargo build -p conference-server --locked && node scripts/with-vivarium.ts vitest run --project integration
scripts.test:e2e: cargo build -p conference-server --locked && pnpm --filter @conference/web build && node scripts/with-vivarium.ts playwright test
